description: Health workforce data and data tool is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Regional Data Hub group and published by Department of Health and Aged Care. Members: Health Workforce Data Tool; Health Workforce Data. Example entry: An interactive data platform provided by the Department of Health and Aged Care, enabling access to different Health Workforce Datasets including the National Health Workforce Dataset. The data is available to the public but users must register first. Users can build their own customised tables for different professions, geographic regions and/or different demographic and health workforce variables. Coverage is Australia, 2009 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML, Report (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated); other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
